description: On the bed in front of you are a small yellow plate, a toy slice of bread, a yellow die, a white block, a pink ring, a small yellow packet, and a pink macaron-shaped piece. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the pink macaron (right-hand object), lifts it, moves it leftward over the bread and die, and places it onto the yellow plate before releasing; the left hand stays low and relaxed without touching anything.
